title: Shared tool repair sentences
description: The repair sentences every tool router shares, keyed by error code. Each tool's conformance fixture merges these with its own table (fixture wins), so a shared sentence is edited once and per-tool codes and overrides stay in the per-tool fixture. A code here may be overridden by a fixture deliberately, but today none is.

repairs.string_too_short: property {name} must be at least {min} characters
repairs.string_too_long: property {name} must be at most {max} characters
repairs.string_pattern: property {name} contains characters that are not allowed
